text: When did the skin/hair problem first start, and how has it changed?
Did the problem begin after starting, stopping, or changing a medication or supplement?
Do you have fever or feel significantly unwell along with the skin problem?
Are there sores or painful lesions in the mouth, eyes, or genital area?
Are you having difficulty breathing or chest symptoms?
Have you developed yellow eyes/skin or dark urine?
Have you lived in or recently travelled to an area where yaws occurs, or had close skin-to-skin contact with an affected person?
Do you have bone or joint pain/swelling associated with the skin lesions?
Are there lesions or ulcers involving the mouth or other mucous membranes?
Is the hair loss diffuse, patchy, or mainly along the hairline/central scalp?
Is there scalp redness, scaling, pain, itching, or scarring?
Did the hair loss follow a major illness, fever, surgery, severe stress, rapid weight change, or childbirth?
Have you started any new medication in the past 2 to 8 weeks?
Do you have any swelling of your face along with the rash and fever?
How long have you noticed increased hair shedding?
Have you had any major illness, surgery, childbirth, or significant stress in the last 3 months?
Is the rash near your eye, on your eyelid, or on the tip of your nose?
Is there redness, swelling, warmth, or pus around the affected nail?
Have you started a new medication recently, and does the rash appear only on skin exposed to sunlight?
Has the lump grown quickly, become hard, or started to hurt?

[LLM DRAFT] Are your skin patches severely swollen, hot, oozing pus, or accompanied by a high fever?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you currently have an open sore, wound, or break in the skin on your foot or ankle?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you notice a foul odor, pus, or red streaks spreading from a sore on your foot?
[LLM DRAFT] Is your foot significantly swollen, red, or feeling unusually hot to the touch around a wound?
[LLM DRAFT] Is the lump under your skin painless, slow-growing, and easily movable?
[LLM DRAFT] Has the skin lump suddenly become extremely painful, red, hot, or started draining pus?
[LLM DRAFT] Are more than 90% of your skin surface areas red, inflamed, and peeling?
[LLM DRAFT] Are you currently experiencing chills, fever, or feeling unusually cold all the time?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you have dark, flat patches of skin on your face, such as on your cheeks, forehead, or upper lip?
[LLM DRAFT] Did these dark skin patches appear or worsen after sun exposure or during hormonal changes like pregnancy or taking birth control pills?
[LLM DRAFT] Do your fingernails or toenails have tiny dents or pits in the surface?
[LLM DRAFT] Have your nails started to separate from the skin underneath or turned a yellowish-brown color like "oil drops"?
[LLM DRAFT] Are your nails noticeably thickened, crumbly, or crumbling away from the nail bed?
[LLM DRAFT] Do your skin rashes appear within hours or days after sun exposure?
[LLM DRAFT] Do the skin bumps or blisters itch intensely?
[LLM DRAFT] Do the skin lesions completely clear up without scarring within a week or two?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you have well-defined, red patches of skin covered with silvery-white scales, especially on your elbows, knees, or scalp?
[LLM DRAFT] Are your joints swollen, stiff, or painful along with your skin rash?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you have an intense, itchy rash that tends to get much worse at night?
[LLM DRAFT] Are you experiencing the itchy rash in skin folds, such as between your fingers, on your wrists, or around your waistline?
[LLM DRAFT] Do others living in your close household currently have a similar itchy rash?
[LLM DRAFT] Do you have smooth white or lighter patches of skin that have appeared suddenly or spread over time?
[LLM DRAFT] Are the white patches on your skin accompanied by any painful blistering, burning, or open sores?
